points.point: The company has secured a substantial credit facility of up to US$100 million from a strategic investor.

quotes.quote: The Company announced that it has executed an unsecured, short and short-term loan agreement (the " Loan ") with a strategic investor for up to US$100 million.

points.point: The financing is specifically intended to fund essential summer season work programs and infrastructure development at the 100% owned KSM Project.

quotes.quote: We are pleased to secure financing to support the significant investments we are making in our summer season work programs at our 100% owned KSM Project.

Our 2026 work programs at KSM include building of roads to provide improved access to future infrastructure areas and the collection of geotechnical, metallurgical and environmental data from drilling, test pitting and sampling required to support KSM's feasibility level design and engineering activities.

points.point: The company can use the loan to bolster its consolidated liquidity position.

quotes.quote: The Company intends to draw on the Loan, if required, to strengthen its consolidated liquidity position.
